How to review and update Khmer translations using this spreadsheet

column3: Instructions & Guide
Upload this workbook to Google Drive and open with Google Sheets (or open in Microsoft Excel).
Navigate to the specific page tab at the bottom (e.g. 'Course Enrollment', 'Explore Courses', etc.).
Review the English text (Column C) and current Khmer translation (Column D).
Whenever you find a Khmer word that needs correction, type your new Khmer word in Column E (highlighted in light green).
Save your file or share the link with us. We will instantly sync your updated Khmer translations into the website!
